name: create_reminder
description: Create reminder notifications and optional Calendar events. Interpret the user's wording into schedule selectors; Jarvis computes and validates dates before saving. Keep when as the original notification schedule and prefer the structured schedule argument for varied phrasing. For Monday at 5pm use kind=weekday, weekday=0, time=17:00; do not compute a calendar date. Keep appointment/event times in title/description, not the notification schedule. Bounded daily spans use ONE call, not separate recurring and one-time reminders. Never approximate unclear times, unsupported recurrence, or missing information: ask for clarification. On success confirm the actual saved result; do not create a replacement to correct or verify it. An invalid_reminder_schedule rejection means nothing was saved; only retry a faithful equivalent interpretation, never discard constraints.

title.description: What to remind the user about. Preserve the subject and any appointment/event time, for example 'Appointment at 2pm' even when the notification is requested for noon. Do not replace the subject with the notification time.

description.description: Optional reminder message/details, including an appointment/event time mentioned by the user. A time in this message is context, not an instruction to create another notification.

when.description: Original notification schedule wording, separate from what the reminder is about. Preserve weekdays, date qualifiers, timezone, and recurrence bounds. Use schedule to represent its meaning without calendar arithmetic. Examples: Monday at 5pm; tomorrow at noon; in 30 minutes; next 5 days at 2pm; every Wednesday at 14:00. For a bare 12-hour clock such as 'tomorrow at 3', ask AM/PM unless the user supplied a daypart; 24-hour clocks are unambiguous. Unsupported or ambiguous wording must be clarified, never shortened to a matching clock.

schedule.description: Optional structured interpretation of when. Prefer this for natural-language variants. Do not drop constraints or replace unsupported schedules with approximations. Fields must match kind; omit irrelevant fields. Defaults use the configured timezone and 10:00 when no clock was requested. Without schedule, when is parsed strictly. relative requires delay_seconds (elapsed time); date requires date; weekday/weekly require weekday; monthly requires day. daily supports optional count/start_offset for bounded daily spans. Use when without schedule for other supported calendar-relative expressions, explicit ISO offsets, and qualifiers such as next/this weekday.

time.description: 24-hour wall clock HH:MM, e.g. 17:00; omit for relative delay.

date.description: Explicit YYYY-MM-DD for kind=date. Use only when the user specified a calendar date; do not calculate one for a weekday.

weekday.description: Monday=0, Tuesday=1, Wednesday=2, Thursday=3, Friday=4, Saturday=5, Sunday=6.

delay_seconds.description: Elapsed duration for kind=relative; do not convert wall-clock calendar days across DST into elapsed hours.

count.description: Number of occurrences, only for a bounded daily schedule.

start_offset.description: Bounded daily only: 0 includes today if its clock is still ahead; 1 starts tomorrow.

timezone.description: Explicit IANA timezone such as America/Los_Angeles or UTC; omit to use configured timezone. Do not guess an ambiguous abbreviation.
